o.text: From Proto-Turkic *artuk, a derivation of Proto-Turkic *art- (“to increase”). Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰺𐱃‬𐰸 (r¹t¹‬wk¹‬‬ /⁠artuq‬‬⁠/, “more, much”), Turkish artık, Kazakh артық (artıq), Chagatai ارتوق (artuq), Uzbek ortiq, Uyghur ئارتۇق (artuq), Chuvash ытах (yt̬ah), ытла (ytla).
From Proto-Turkic *sEŕ- (~*sēŕ-). Cognate with Turkish sezmek.
